scenarios.scenario_abstract: While completing a comfortable minimalist outfit around a white T-shirt, [X] narrows the lower half to slim-fit jeans and checks whether the pair will remain comfortable through mild spring and fall days, from cooler mornings and warmer afternoons to periods spent wearing an added outer layer.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 围绕白色 T 恤完善一套舒适的极简穿搭时，[X]把裤装缩小到一条修身牛仔裤，并判断它在温和但有温差的春秋日常里是否始终舒适，包括偏凉的早晨、较暖的下午以及加穿外套后的状态。
examples: keeping the jeans in rotation for mild transitional weather
switching to a different lower garment when the afternoon becomes too warm
checking whether the same pair still works once an outer layer is added

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For school days that begin cool and turn warmer by afternoon, [X] builds a small transitional capsule wardrobe, assigning different roles to jeans, skirts, and shorts while keeping the total number of pieces low enough for repeated combinations.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 面对早晨偏凉、下午转暖的上学日，[X]会搭建一个小型换季胶囊衣橱，在牛仔裤、半裙和短裤之间分配不同作用，同时把单品数量控制到足以反复组合的程度。
examples: using jeans or a skirt when the day begins cool
retaining shorts only for the reliably warmer part of the season
favoring lower garments that can repeat across spring and fall layers

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a short spring trip from Marseille to the breezier Calanques, [X] and two friends choose among jeans, trousers, and optional shorts for city meals, a boat ride or hike, possible showers, and the limits of a two-night bag.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为一趟从马赛前往风更大的卡朗格的春季短途旅行，[X]和两位朋友需要在牛仔裤、长裤和可选短裤之间取舍，以应对城市用餐、乘船或徒步、可能的阵雨以及仅住两晚的有限行李。
examples: packing one long bottom for wind and evening temperature drops
adding shorts only when the warmer forecast and activity justify them
repeating a versatile pair rather than carrying a separate bottom for every stop

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before traveling across India, [X] maps lower-body needs to sharply different regional seasons: hot plains and humid coasts, heavy monsoon rain, cool post-monsoon evenings, and winter conditions ranging from a mild south to a cold or snowy north.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在前往印度多地旅行前，[X]会把下装需求对应到差异很大的地区与季节：炎热平原和湿热海岸、强降雨季、转凉的雨后秋季夜晚，以及从温和南部到寒冷甚至降雪北部的冬季。
examples: prioritizing breathable coverage in summer heat
using quick-dry lower garments during monsoon travel
leaving room for thermal layering in northern winter conditions

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After choosing the time of year and trip format together, [X] decides whether the lower-body system needs waterproof outer pants, thermal base bottoms, or both for wind, rain, snow, long outdoor stretches, and rapidly changing conditions.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把出行季节与行程方式一起确定后，[X]会判断下装系统需要防水外裤、保暖打底裤，还是两者都要，以应对风雨、降雪、长时间户外活动和快速变化的天气。
examples: using waterproof pants for exposed wet-weather days
adding thermal bottoms for winter or colder shoulder-season travel
avoiding an insulated system when a milder summer route does not require it

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an international trip spanning uncertain climates, [X] limits the bag to two lower garments whose complementary roles can cover tropical heat, a wet spell, large day-night temperature swings, and a colder stop, without relying on heavy denim that dries slowly.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为一趟气候尚不完全确定的国际旅行，[X]把下装限制为两件，并让它们承担互补作用，以覆盖热带高温、潮湿降雨、明显昼夜温差和较冷的一站，同时避免携带干得很慢的厚重牛仔裤。
examples: using a lightweight quick-dry bottom for heat and rain
choosing a second bottom that accepts a thermal layer
favoring a convertible or broadly reusable piece for transitional weather

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After settling on a May week in Sharm El Sheikh, [X] selects light lower garments that can move between the beach, boat outings, a hot desert safari, market walking, and a breezier evening, rather than packing for extreme midsummer heat or a cool winter stay.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 确定五月去沙姆沙伊赫一周后，[X]会选择能在海滩、乘船、炎热的沙漠活动、市场步行和稍有凉风的夜晚之间切换的轻薄下装，而不是按盛夏极端高温或冬季偏凉条件来准备。
examples: packing shorts for hot daytime and water-adjacent activities
keeping one light lower option for a breezy evening
avoiding heavy cold-season bottoms for the chosen month

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Drawing on hiking experience and one free week in July, [X] compares a snowy, icy Tasmanian route with a dry-season trail near Alice Springs, changing the lower-body plan from waterproof winter layers and snow protection to lighter hiking coverage for cool desert mornings and mild days.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 凭借既有徒步经验和七月的一周空闲时间，[X]会比较可能冰雪交加的塔斯马尼亚线路与爱丽斯泉附近的旱季线路；下装计划也会从防水冬季层和雪地保护，切换为适合清凉沙漠清晨与温和白天的轻量徒步覆盖。
examples: requiring waterproof and thermal lower layers for the winter alpine route
using lighter hiking bottoms for the dry northern alternative
letting seasonal safety determine the route before optimizing style or pack weight

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For two September weeks across Seoul, Gyeongju, Busan, and Jeju, [X] packs one manageable suitcase and balances jeans or light trousers with skirts or shorts as late-summer humidity gives way to cooler autumn air and coastal wind.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备九月在首尔、庆州、釜山和济州旅行两周时，[X]只带一只便于移动的行李箱，并在牛仔裤或轻薄长裤与半裙或短裤之间平衡，以适应月初残留的夏季湿热、随后转凉的秋意和海岛风。
examples: keeping a breathable option for warmer early-trip days
using jeans or light trousers as evenings cool
avoiding overpacking by choosing bottoms that work in several cities

scenarios.scenario_abstract: On a cloudy, slightly cold day, [X] builds an outfit around an owned thin black bomber jacket and chooses between dark jeans and chinos by checking current warmth, possible damp ground, walking comfort, and whether the same lower half will still work if the temperature rises later.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在一个多云、稍冷的日子里，[X]会围绕已有的黑色薄款飞行夹克搭配，并在深色牛仔裤和斜纹裤之间选择；判断依据包括当前保暖度、可能潮湿的地面、步行舒适性，以及稍后升温时同一条下装是否仍合适。
examples: choosing dark jeans for a cool damp transitional day
using lighter chinos when later warming matters more
revising the lower half after testing it with the owned jacket
